content:
Hi,

Could I be granted write access request to non-master branches of mathlib? My GitHub is aditya-ramabadran and I've been contributing to formal-conjectures so far but would like to try potentially contributing the following to mathlib:

  • resolving small issues like https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/issues/31745
  • looking into whether some small generic lemmas from my formal-conjectures work are worth upstreaming to mathlib, especially around Euclidean exponential / Fourier-type functions and their L² / MemLp properties on finite-measure sets
  • looking into whether general lemmas and defs about spectral pairs and spectral sets are worth adding to Mathlib

Thanks!

Hello :wave:
Mathlib does not give write access to contributors, see How to contribute to mathlib
Also, missing 1398 theorems is not a small issue, but it'd be amazing if you can solve it
Oh I see thanks! Sorry I didn't mean to call it a small issue, I meant resolving individual instances like for Function.Surjective and potentially not all 1398 :)
Where are you reading that you need to ask for write access for non-master branches of mathlib? These instructions are out of date and ideally we'd remove them if we can track them down!
Ah, I believe I accidentally read the Lean3 (very outdated) version of the contribution site: https://leanprover-community.github.io/lean3/contribute/index.html by misclicking on Google
